packages/cli/include/OpenMS/APPLICATIONS.scope: Lifecycle closure CLI-1 and CLI-2 (registration, the command-line parse closure, INI merge and strict update, -write_ini parity, file and format checks, usage text, exit codes, processing records; 87 executed cases of the product SDK in ../oracle/topp-cli-lifecycle) and, in the TOPPBase completion lane (2026-09-21), every remaining member against the C++ Release build at the pins (124 cases executed by ../oracle/toppbase-completion/cases.sh, 93 retained in tests/data/topp_cli_completion and compared in tests/topp_cli_completion.rs): the product version from the tool registry (ToolHandler) with the core-version fallback and the 'Common UTIL options:' heading of an unregistered tool; -write_ctd through ParamCtdFile, byte-identical to the Release build's CTD for the seven ported tools that declare their citations; -write_cwl/-write_nested_cwl/-write_json/-write_nested_json refused with the Release build's TDL message and exit 12 (the Release build also empties the target, CPP-350; the port does not); the writers' target checks (exit 5) and a directory target (exit 12); -instance selecting <tool>:<n>: for the INI copy, the defaults and -write_ini; -log and -debug (writeLogInfo_/Warn_/Error_, writeDebug_ at levels, the 'Writing to' notice, the accessors' 'Value of ... option' lines, removal of an empty log file) against the Release log files; getToolUserDefaults_ (<user dir>/<Tool>.ini, lenient update, exit 3 for a malformed file and 12 for a directory); checkParam_'s warnings; an INI 'type' item; citations (Tool::CITATIONS, the 'To cite <tool>:' block and the CTD DOIs); is_executable inputs resolved on PATH (exit 14 otherwise); getOutputDirOption (ToolContext::output_dir); the integer parseRange_ (parse_range_int); the closing '<tool> took ...' line after the body, none after write_failure; Param::update's diagnostics at the end of standard error as the Release build prints them; the source's 'could not be found' wording. The executables on a console (src/cli/console.rs, ../oracle/toppbase-completion/console.sh, 100 cases compared in tests/topp_cli_console.rs and 15 in a pseudo-terminal): printUsage_ shaped to COLUMNS or 'stty size' item by item as IndentedStream and ConsoleUtils::breakString_ shape it, including the source's wrap-around (CPP-353), Colorizer's codes on a terminal, the lifecycle's writeLogError_/OPENMS_LOG_ERROR lines red and writeLogWarn_/Param::update lines yellow, and the exit-time terminal reset; run_with (explicit streams) stays unshaped and uncoloured. Upstream tests transcribed: all TOPPBase_test.cpp sections except the four getStringOption_ INI cases, which read what the source's non-atomic strict update leaves behind after it fails and have no observable counterpart (the command-line getIniLocation_ case is transcribed through the log file); ToolManifest_test.cpp's TOPPBase sections. PARTIAL, remaining (ranked by the tools they affect): (1) JSON INI files, ParamJSONFile::load, which the Release build applies without TDL (all 108 tools; needs serde_json behind the paramxml feature, a Cargo.toml change); (2) the exit code of a tool body's own InvalidValue/InvalidRange (source 8, port 6): the crate-wide arm cannot move until the tools that use Error::InvalidValue for an explicit ILLEGAL_PARAMETERS return that code themselves (tried: MzMLSplitter, MapNormalizer, FileInfo, SpectraFilterWindowMower and the lifecycle case then disagree); (3) UnregisteredParameter/WrongParameterType escaping a body exit 6 where the source exits 12 (programming errors only); (4) FeatureFinderCentroided does not declare its two citations (src/cli/tools, another lane), so its usage and CTD lack them; (5) on a terminal, the error and warning lines a tool body writes itself are uncoloured (FileInfo's 'Error: Can only validate indices for mzML files', PeakPickerHiRes' and FeatureFinderCentroided's messages; src/cli/tools, other lanes; cli::log_error/log_warning colour them), and on Windows the console width comes only from COLUMNS (the standard library cannot read the console buffer). Carried from the earlier waves: a single-writer FIFO -ini is read once where C++ blocks (deliberate); -in /dev/null exits 2 where C++ exits 4; an input of unknown name and content exits 6 and a directory -in exits 8 where C++ exits 3 (FileHandler follow-ups); ToolContext::in_thread_pool builds a pool for one worker; five tools build the -threads pool and leave it idle.

ParameterInformation and ParameterTypes become ParameterInformation and ParameterType in src/cli/parameter.rs: all 16 types with the source's discriminants and all 13 data members; the source's default constructor (required=true) is Default, the detailed constructor is new plus with_tags (tag_values), operator= is Clone. The restriction members are Option where the source holds +-numeric_limits::max() sentinels, and a native valid_formats keeps file formats apart from valid_strings (the source packs them into valid_strings); ParameterInformation::accepted_formats reads either. paramEntryToParameterInformation_, getParamArgument_ and paramToParameterInformation_ are folded into ParameterInformation::from_param_entry. ParameterInformation_test.cpp (cli c19e494) is transcribed with its literals, the sentinel comparisons as the Option and as the value consumers read.

Citation (authors, title, when_where, doi and toString, as Citation::to_source_string and Display) and TOPPBase::cite_openms (CITE_OPENMS) in src/cli/defs.rs; tools declare citations as Tool::CITATIONS, printed by --help and written to the CTD, checked against the Release build (ffc_help_cite, ctd_FeatureFinderCentroided) and TOPPBase_test.cpp's Citation::toString section. The three exception classes are not types: RequiredParameterNotGiven is the lifecycle's required-value check with the source's message and exit 7; UnregisteredParameter and WrongParameterType are Error::InvalidValue from the ToolContext accessors, which a body that lets them escape ends with exit 6 where the source exits 12 (programming errors, documented).

ToolHandler with getTOPPToolList, getToolVersion, findExecutable, getTypes, getCategory and getInternalToolsPath (get_topp_tool_list, get_tool_version, find_executable, get_types, get_category, get_internal_tools_path), ToolListType, and the private packageTools, prefixes, getInternalTools_ and getInternalToolConfigFiles_ (package_tools, internal_tool_config_files, ToolRegistrySources): OPENMS_TOOL_PREFIX_PATH with the platform separator, the executable's prefix and the macOS bundle prefix, the manifest rules (four tab-separated fields, no empty name/version/executable, no path separator in a name, no absolute or climbing executable path, no duplicate) with the source's InvalidValue/FileNotReadable/filesystem_error texts, the DesktopViewer/DesktopWorkflow exclusion, the .ttd registry cached after its first successful read, and findExecutable's package, sibling and PATH resolution. ToolHandler_test.cpp and ToolManifest_test.cpp (cli c19e494) are transcribed with the package's fixture registry; 25 registry and .ttd cases are compared with the Release build (reg_*, ttd_*). Native differences, documented: the Release build's topp.tools.tsv (resources/tools, byte-identical) is compiled in and read in place of an executable prefix without share/openms4/tools; the dladdr library prefix is the executable's; manifests are read ordered by name; a missing shared-data directory means no internal tools rather than FileNotFound; a malformed .ttd is exit 6 with this reader's wording.
